description: Predict zinc and potential transition-metal binding sites in protein structures.
functions: Accepts experimental or predicted protein structures in PDB or mmCIF format.
Returns coordinating residues, predicted ion coordinates, template matches and site probabilities as CSV and JSON.
Optional histidine rotamer sampling is enabled by default.
Trained on zinc sites; can also detect potential Fe, Mn, Co, Cu and Ni sites, without identifying the bound metal.
Development preview with reproducibility fixes; historical outputs can differ and published accuracy benchmarks have not been re-established for this revision.

inputs.name: structure
inputs.descr: Upload one structure, at most 5 MB and 4,000 protein residues. Uses the first model and all its protein chains.

inputs.name: minimum_probability
inputs.descr: Output filter; 0.0001 matches the notebook cutoff. This cutoff is not a biological confidence threshold.

inputs.name: max_sites
inputs.descr: Whole number. Returns highest-probability sites; JSON records the total count and whether results were truncated.
